subtitle: Lesson 8 · Containerizing AI Applications

code:
# Loose - resolves differently every time
torch
transformers

# Pinned - resolves to the exact same build, every time
torch==2.3.1
transformers==4.41.2
caption: A minor version bump can silently change a model's numerical output.

eyebrow: Option 1 & 2: bake in, or download at build
code:
# Bake it into the image
COPY model/model.safetensors /app/model/

# Or download it at build time
RUN curl -L -o model.safetensors \
  https://example.com/weights/v2.safetensors
caption: Self-contained but heavy, vs. small but dependent on a reachable URL.

eyebrow: Option 3: mount weights as a volume
caption: Image stays small and generic; weights are swappable without a rebuild.

code:
Small, stable model (<100MB)      -> bake it in
Weights from a model registry      -> download at build
Large, swapped often, or GPU deploy -> mount as a volume
caption: Volumes are also what makes GPU deployments (Lesson 11) practical.
